message: No detected input validation: User inputs from st.number_input are passed directly to the classifier without any range checks, type assertions, or schema validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local CSV file and pickle files with no checksum verification, integrity checks, or source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label values against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no use of tools like Cleanlab to detect label noise or flipping.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code performs only a train/test split with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the training samples.
No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pickle files directly with no hash check, signature verification, or any other integrity verification before deserializing the model.
No detected label distribution validation: The code loads data and splits it without any check on class balance, expected label set, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism is imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/test split is performed, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no holdout set isolated from training, and scaler fit_transform is incorrectly applied to the test set (commented out but shows intent); no multiple independent evaluation pipelines or integrity checks are pres
No detected input sanitization: User inputs from st.number_input are passed directly to classifier.predict() without any range checks, shape validation, or schema enforcement.
No detected output bounds checks: The result of classifier.predict() is used directly with no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation before being displayed.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular ML classification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
